Passionate about improving data quality, enabling trusted data, and supporting governance frameworks for business and regulatory compliance.

Regulatory & Domain : FFIEC Reporting Support, BCBS 239, Basel Framework, DAMA-DMBOK, Regulatory Reporting, Credit Card Domain, Consumer Banking, Risk Data Management, Compliance Support

Tools : Collibra, SQL, JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Word, Canva, Figma
